name: Lanteeb
description: Lanteeb was a neutral pastoral planet in the Malor-77 system. While aligned with the Galactic Republic, it did not have a representative in the Galactic Senate. It was located equidistant between Rattatak and Bespin. It was located in Bri'ahl sector.
